content.title: Soybean-Market Uncertainty Strikes ADM
content.summary: Weaker soybean prices are hurting Archer Daniels Midland’s business.  Bumper crops in North and South America are filling grain elevators.  China’s limited purchases of soybeans from the U.S. this year have created a supply glut, pressuring crop prices.
